Introduction

TST (formerly known as Top Secret) was a South Korean boy group under KJ Music Entertainment. Originally a seven-member group, they debuted on January 4, 2017, with their first mini album Time's Up. They are presumably disbanded due to inactivity since October 2020.

On May 24, 2018, it was reported that Kyeongha was found guilty of sexual assault. The victim stated that Kyeongha assaulted her in December 2014. His management agency initially denied the accusation when the victim's online post began to circulate after his debut with the group. The victim then filed a lawsuit in April 2017. Kyeongha and his agency, JSL Company, denied the allegations and filed an appeal on May 29. However, on May 31, 2018, he received a prison sentence of 18 months with a three-year probation period, along with 40 hours of a treatment program for sexual offenders. On June 11, 2018, it was announced that Kyeongha had left the group.

In 2019, Wooyoung went on hiatus due to health reasons.

On February 20, 2019, KJ Music announced through TST's fan cafè that member K would enlist on March 21, 2019, to complete his mandatory service. On April 17, 2020, KJ Music revealed that Ain had quietly enlisted in the military following his basic training on April 6.

On June 16, 2020, member Yohan sadly passed away at the age of 28. The cause of death was not revealed at the family's request.

On October 16, 2020, Junghoon announced his departure from the group.
